en: The image shows an old industrial complex, likely a factory, with two tall smokestacks emitting smoke. The buildings are large, multi-story, and constructed in a utilitarian architectural style typical of late 19th or early 20th century factories in Europe. In the background, there is a river or body of water and a townscape. The photo is in sepia tone, suggesting age. In the bottom right corner, faint text is visible.
